subject: general
question: The Fifth Assembly of International Solar Alliance took place in _________ in October 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Option 1**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **International Solar Alliance's Fifth Assembly **to be held in **New Delhi **from **17th to 20th October, 2022**.
 
• India holds the office of the President of the** ISA Assembly**.
 
• Ministers, missions and delegates from **109 Member** and Signatory Countries are set to participate in this meeting.
 
• The Assembly will be presided over by** Shri R.K. Singh, Union Minister for Power, New and Renewable Energy.**
 
• **Shri R.K Singh **emphasized that India is leading the global energy transition with unmatched speed.
 
• He highlighted the indispensable role of the **International Solar Alliance** in achieving our planet's energy transition objectives.
 
• The minister emphasized the significance of solar power as the most affordable energy source, stating that solar and mini grids hold the key to ensuring universal access to energy worldwide.
